thread:
marta: Hey folks — released opencontrib-proxy-adapter v0.1.0 :tada: Lightweight adapter for connecting model proxies to Redwood's routing. GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/opencontrib-proxy-adapter/releases/tag/v0.1.0. Notes below.
opensource-bot: Release created by marta — assets: tar.gz, docker image, changelog.
alex: Nice! Any breaking changes we should watch for?
marta: One config key renamed: proxyUrl -> upstream_url. Also default retry policy added (3 retries). See migration snippet.
josh: What's the license?
marta: MIT.
ria: Will there be a maintainer office hour for adoption Qs?
marta: Yep — Wed 10:00am PST, Zoom link: https://meet.redwood.ai/oss-office-hours — will drop calendar invite.
alex: Quick install for node:
```
npm install @redwood/open-proxy-adapter@0.1.0
```
marta: migration YAML example:
```
# before
proxy:
  proxyUrl: "https://upstream.example"

# after
proxy:
  upstream_url: "https://upstream.example"
  retry:
    attempts: 3
```
alex: Will test in staging tomorrow. Any compat notes for Dedicated?
marta: Compatible — Dedicated uses the same adapter image, just set REDWOOD_ADAPTER_MODE=dedicated. If using VPC, ensure the adapter has network route to upstream.
josh: Who's the point of contact for backporting fixes to v0.1.x?
marta: ping @marta and @alex — we'll tag in the repo.
ria: :tada: congrats all — I'll promote in community channels later.
alex: :shipit:
marta: Thanks team! If you hit issues, file GH issue and tag `triage/adapter`.
